engine.notes: The Box downtown is the scene's centre of gravity and the only dedicated improv theatre in New Mexico; Improv New Mexico added pay-what-you-can longform training in 2019, and indie longform teams such as The Faculty Lounge and The Boyz play fourth Mondays at The Shop NM. Blackout Theatre (founded 2007) lists no current improv shows.

entries.name: The Box Performance Space & Improv Theatre
entries.summary: New Mexico's only dedicated improv theatre, with a Mainstage and Annex at 100 Gold Ave SW. Home of The Show, the city's longest-running comedy show, and a five-level training programme.
entries.schedule: The Show Fri & Sat 8pm; The Nightcap Fridays 9:15pm; The Jam last Thursdays 7:30pm (free)
signals: The Show has run weekly for over a decade
Free jam on the last Thursday of the month
entries.reasons: The state's only purpose-built improv theatre with a decade-old weekly show, a full class ladder with dated terms, a free monthly jam and a current calendar.

entries.name: Improv New Mexico
entries.area: San Mateo Blvd NE (black box theater)
entries.summary: A pay-what-you-can nonprofit founded in 2019 that teaches longform and sketch in eight-week levels from its Albuquerque black box, with student shows, a monthly open mic and the late-night Midnight Mass longform challenge.
entries.schedule: Open Mic Night 2nd Fridays 8pm; Midnight Mass 2nd Wednesdays 10pm; DED ASSSS improv show 4th Mondays
signals: Five longform levels from Intro to Improv Lab, plus sketch writing and acting
Student showcases followed by an all-play jam
Statewide programme with a Santa Fe base
entries.reasons: A clear beginner-to-performing longform path and a lively calendar, but it is seven years old and its shows are monthly rather than weekly.

entries.name: Cardboard Playhouse Theatre Company
entries.area: Classes held at The Box, downtown
entries.summary: A youth theatre company whose Youth Improv (ages 9-13) and Advanced Youth Improv (ages 10-14) classes meet Saturdays at The Box Performance Space.
signals: Youth improv for ages 9-14, $225 a term
Also runs musical theatre classes and show choirs
entries.reasons: A current, dated youth improv programme in a real theatre, but nothing for adults and no public improv shows.

entries.name: Improv Underground
entries.summary: A small independent improv school run by Mary Ashley Bannister, who trained at iO West, Second City Hollywood and UCB; teaching since spring 2025 with student shows since spring 2026.
signals: Student bill of rights adapted from Camp Improv Utopia
Class and show calendar on the site
entries.reasons: Real and current but barely a year old, with no venue of its own and a site whose class and show listings load only in the calendar.
